conclusion: On clean labels at seed 7, OLS achieved lower MSE (0.17046895861013783) than the matched training-mean predictor (12.888358499556563). This is a preliminary single-seed result and does not establish general scientific value.
limitations: Only seed 7 was run; seeds 19 and 31 were not executed.
Only mse was computed; mae and median_absolute_error were not executed.
Single-seed, single-metric preliminary result; no uncertainty estimate or significance test.
No claim of general scientific value is made.
